verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents a built-in AI Assistant you chat with to plan, prioritize, and optimize your schedule. A 2.0 'Schedule Assistant' acts as a control center that suggests next actions and lets you preview changes before deploying them. This sits on top of an engine that auto-schedules and reschedules your calendar for you. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on what the chat assistant can actually execute versus only suggest, any delegation beyond calendar and scheduling scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the chat assistant itself (community praise covers the auto-scheduling bot, not the chat interface).
